mode: Public static APK contract summary and isolated synthetic verification; no raw decompiled source, account data, phone credentials or live writes

gsonFields.role: original feed author UID; distinct from comment author uid
4 means hidden; other explicitly provided integer statuses are not the author-hidden state
server permission signal and remaining daily quota

permission.display: Authenticated current UID must equal FeedReply.feedUid, comment fid must match current feed, and nonempty valid server userHideReplyRemaining plus explicit block_status must be provided.
permission.write: Before each mutation, fresh feed/replyDetail and feed/detail must match the requested identifiers and agree on the original author UID. Remaining quota must be greater than zero for hide and resume.
permission.hiddenAction: block_status=4 -> resumeHideReply; otherwise hideReply. No missing-state default is used.
permission.quotaExhausted: The mobile click handler blocks both hide and cancel-hidden when remaining quota is exhausted. Desktop displays a disabled action and the same limit meaning.
permission.confirmation: Explicit confirmation explains that hiding reduces exposure; the reply may remain viewable.
permission.conservativeLimits: No default quota, role assumption, renderer UID claim, list-range filter or absent field grants permission. Missing/invalid server fields prevent mutation.

response.apkCallback: Shows server string and emits a current-reply refresh event; this alone does not prove durable server state.
response.desktopConfirmation: After a known string response, reread the same original reply and feed, preserve ownership/context validation and require the expected block_status. A verified readback may report remaining quota zero without invalidating the already-completed action.
response.unconfirmed: Unknown response shape, lost response, failed/mismatched readback or missing permission/quota remains WRITE_UNCONFIRMED. UI retains the list and offers a read-only original-comment check without automatic write replay.
response.idempotentRead: If a fresh matching reply is already in the requested target state, return confirmed unchanged without a mutation or quota consumption. This does not permit an actual resume at zero quota.
response.accountScope: Native AccountScope.capture clones identity and checks its epoch before each fetch and again at callApi completion; renderer commit-time generation guards reject old account results and old verification callbacks.

implementation.listState: Replace only confirmed reply records, retaining sort, loaded pages, expanded replies and scroll. A newer successful page-one response or filter/sort/revision/focused-target refresh supersedes local overlays.

acceptance.isolatedCoreAndRenderer: tested with synthetic responses and external network blocked
remaining: Real quota consumption and visibility after an authorized hide/resume roundtrip
Exact live server result strings and permission/limit/captcha failures
Administrator or moderator hide capabilities outside the original-author contract
